note: FED-EDU Discussions configuration — mirrors the categories we set up in GitHub's Discussions tab (Settings → Discussions → New category). This file is our record of the block's porch layout. When GitHub's UI lets you import/export discussion categories, this is the source of truth. Keep them in sync.
setup_instructions: Enable Discussions: repo Settings → General → Features → check Discussions
Create these categories IN ORDER (order matters for the porch flow): Announcements, Introduce Yourself, Q&A, Show and Tell, Ideas, General
Pin the three pinned posts from discussion/pinned/ (see README in that folder)
Set Announcements to 'Only maintainers can start' — everything else open to all members
Link the welcome readme: the first post brothers see is discussion/pinned/welcome-to-the-block.md content

categories.name: Announcements
categories.description: Official block news — raffles, releases, town halls. Maintainers only.

categories.name: Introduce Yourself
categories.description: New brothers post here first. City + hardware + what you're trying to build. The welcome agent greets every intro within 24 hours.

categories.name: Q&A
categories.description: Any question, any level. Rule 1 of the block: no stupid questions. Mark answers that solved it so the next brother finds them fast.

categories.name: Show and Tell
categories.description: Built something? ANYTHING? Post it. First buttons count. Broken-but-learned counts double.

categories.name: Ideas
categories.description: Pitches for the block: features, courses, hustles, partnerships. Ideas are contributions — they earn tickets.

categories.name: General
categories.description: The porch. Life, wins, Ls, grief, game night, whatever's heavy or light. Brothers here.
